 Dated this the 17th day of November, 2023  ORDER
These applications are filed under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, seeking pre-arrest bail.

The petitioner is the 2nd accused in Crime 1192/2023 of Kottayam East Police Station, Kottayam District, for having allegedly committed offences punishable under Sections 406, 420 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code.

sentences.text:
The prosecution case is that the accused 1 to 3, in furtherance to their common intention to have wrongful gain and to cause wrongful loss to the defacto complainant, had received an amount of Rs.
2,00,000/- (Rupees Two Lakhs only) on 22.04.2022 and Rs.8,00,000/- (Eight Lakhs only) on 06.05.2023 from the defacto complainant through the account of the institution of Mr.Sajin Dev namely V-Phoenix Consultants Pvt. Ltd, on giving promise that they would arrange a job to the defacto complainant as a teaching staff in an N.S.S. Higher Secondary School, retracted from the promise and assurances and thereby committed the B.A.Nos. 9576 & 9575/2023 ..4..
aforesaid offences.

The petitioner is the 2nd accused in Crime No.398/2023 of Kudiyanmala Police Station, Kannur District, for having allegedly committed offences punishable under Sections 406, 420 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code.

5. The prosecution case is that the accused, in furtherance to their common intention to cheat the defacto complainant, had forged documents and given false promise that they would arrange a job for the defacto complainant as a teaching staff in an N.S.S. Higher Secondary School and thereby received an amount of Rs. 10,00,000/- (Rupees Ten Lakhs only) on different occasions through accounts, during the period from 26.04.2022 to 07.05.2022; and later retracted from the promise and assurances and thereby committed the offences.
6. The learned counsel appearing for the petitioner and the learned Public Prosecutor were heard.
7. Learned Public Prosecutor submits that the petitioner had appeared before the investigating officer in response to the notice under Section 41A and had cooperated with the investigation.

Under such circumstances, I am inclined to grant anticipatory bail to the petitioner, as B.A.Nos. 9576 &
9575/2023 ..5..
custodial interrogation is not required.
Accordingly, this application is allowed, and the petitioner granted bail subject to the following conditions:-
( i ) The petitioner is directed to surrender before the Investigating Officer within a week from today, and on such surrender, the Investigating Officer can interrogate the petitioner.
In the event of her arrest, the Investigating officer shall produce the petitioner before the jurisdictional court on the date of surrender itself.

(ii) On such production, the jurisdictional court shall release the petitioner on bail,
on executing a bond for Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty five thousand only) by the petitioner and by two solvent sureties each for the like sum to the satisfaction of the jurisdictional court.
